olivia: Quick vendor sync recap  asked vendors for a single embargo doc + SI onramp checklist. Gaudi APAC dates still not firm, flagged as the main risk.
ken: Marketplace callout  we need 72h to stage AMIs/SKUs and validate billing. If H100 wave stays early June, assets must land by 2026-06-03 COB.
dmitri: SI note  partners request 48h to certify after we hand off artifacts. We can reduce to 36h if vendors include driver/CUDA-ROCm metadata and pre-signed image URLs.
harper: PR/legal asks  every vendor provide a DO NOT SHARE list during embargo and one short embargo-safe line for social leaks. Also insist on UTC windows. :mega:
olivia: Tentative embargo windows (UTC):
- H100/H200/B200: 2026-06-06 10:00 -> 2026-06-06 16:00
- MI300: 2026-06-13 09:00 -> 2026-06-13 15:00
- Gaudi: rolling by region 2026-06-21 -> 2026-06-27 (APAC gating)
ken: If vendors miss the 6/3 asset drop we should push the H100 announcement rather than rush staging. Marketplace will not accept partial assets.
dmitri: I'll publish a short SI checklist today: image filename + sha256, driver matrix, example launch config, perf baseline CSV, rollback tag, contact matrix. Also adding a CI job. Example SHA check: `ACTUAL=$(sha256sum golden-image.tar.gz|awk '{print $1}') && test "$ACTUAL" = "EXPECTED_SHA"`
ops_bot: Calendar created: "GPU Partner Embargo + SI Onramp" https://calendar.example.com/event/2160000000. Staging bucket: s3://partners/stage/2160000000 (request access via Notion).
olivia: Owners & next steps:
- dmitri: post SI checklist + CI snippet by 2160000020 UTC
- ken: confirm marketplace staging window & billing mapping by 2160000040 UTC
- harper: draft consolidated embargo doc + DO NOT SHARE template by 2160000050 UTC
- vendors: confirm final artifact drop dates by 2160000060 UTC
ken: Flagging @marketplace-team for billing SKU readiness. If any vendor needs a private demo carveout, note the NDA and include him in this thread.
harper: Legal will allow 1:1 demo carveouts with signed NDA only; I'll circulate template.
olivia: Thanks all  keep replies inline so we have a single thread of truth. If Gaudi firm dates move, call it out here immediately.
